rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING THE PROVISIONS ON VAGRANCY AND AMENDING THE LAW ON PROSTITUTION AS DEFINED AND PENALIZED IN ARTICLE 202 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to decriminalize vagrancy, to redefine prostitution to include men, and to change the penalty for prostitution from arresto menor to destierro or banishment to enable prostitutes to start a new life. However, it proposes to impose stricter penalties for recidivist prostitutes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-04

rows.abstract: The bill seeks to increase the following insurance benefits of local government officials: a) death and burial; b) total and permanent incapacity or disability; and c) injuries resulting from an accident.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING PREPARATORY EDUCATION AS COMPULSORY PART OF BASIC PRIMARY EDUCATION IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Preparatory Education Act.\" The bill seeks to make preparatory education (one year schooling before Grade I) mandatory for all five-year old children as part of the formal elementary education. The pre-school program shall be made available for free.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.status: Substituted by HB05649

rows.author: E042
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN FAMILY BONDING BY PROVIDING MORE TIME AND OPPORTUNITY FOR TOGETHERNESS
rows.abstract: \"Family Bonding Act.\" To enable families to enjoy long week-ends, the bill provides for non-working holidays falling on Tuesdays and Wednesdays to be observed on Mondays and for non-working holidays falling on Thursdays to be observed on Fridays. However, the observance of Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Christmas Day and New Year's Day shall be exempt from the proposal.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2005-03-16

rows.author: C019
rows.title_full: AN ACT MODIFYING THE DEFINITION OF A CONDOMINIUM UNIT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4726, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONDOMINIUM LAW, TO APPLY TO INDUSTRIAL ESTATES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: In keeping with the mandate under the Constitution, the bill redefines the interest subject of ownership in a condominium project, especially as regards those in industrial estates, without granting ownership to foreign investors.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (SME) BUSINESS CENTERS (SMEBC) IN ALL REGIONAL AND PROVINCIAL CENTERS IN THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: \"SME Business Center (SMEBC) Act of 2004.\" The proposed SMEBC shall house all the government agencies involved in setting up a business from registration up to the last requirement. It shall also provide enterprenuers with all the basic information in establishing and running a business.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05811

rows.abstract: \"Public Debt Ceiling Act.\" The bill proposes to set a ceiling on the total public debt of the country at US$1.2 trillion which may not be exceeded except with the concurrence of two-thirds of all members of Congress voting separately.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE THE MANDATORY ROADWORTHINESS INSPECTION OF VEHICLES TEN YEARS OLD AND ABOVE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to require all ten to fifteen-year old vehicles to pass a road-worthiness inspection test (RIT) every two years prior to registration by the Land Transportation office. Older vehicles shall be required to pass the RIT every year.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TAX AND DUTY EXEMPTION PRIVILEGES FOR THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE THRU ITS PNP SERVICE STORE SYSTEM
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant direct and indirect tax and duty exemptions for all purchases from local manufacturers, suppliers, and producers made by the Philippine National Police Service Store System.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENCOURAGING THE CONSTRUCTION, ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF PRIVATE PORTS IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR RELATED PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Encouraging the Construction, Establishment and Operation of Private Ports in the Philippines
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to allow private and public entities to construct, establish and operate a port even without prior approval by the Philippine Ports Authority provided that the operation of the port is directly connected to and is an integral part of the principal business of said entity and is for its exclusive use.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2006-06-07

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE LOCAL MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM
rows.title_short: Local Management Information System Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Local Management Information System Act of 2004.\" The local management information system is envisioned to provide management information to all local government units in order to strengthen local government administration.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF THE PHILIPPINE MERCHANT MARINE OFFICERS LAW
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the use of naval vessels, which are not engaged in emergencies, for the training of future deck officers, engineers and crewmen apart from the traditional vessels used during apprenticeship training.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR BARANGAY EMPOWERMENT, AMENDING VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Barangay Empowerment Act of 2004.\" The bill provides for the creation of a Barangay Building Official in all barangays with a population of at least 3,000 inhabitants. It also proposes to increase the share in the resources tax collection of the barangay where the sand, gravel and other quarry resources are extract.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PRACTICE OF OFFERING, GIVING OR ATTEMPTING TO GIVE OR OFFER, OR ACCEPTING A KICKBACK IN ANY KIND OF COMMERCIAL TRANSACTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Kickback Act.\" The bill provides a penaly of imprisonment of not less than 5 years but not more than 20 years and a fine of not less than P5,000 but not more than three times the amount of the kickback, whichever is higher on any person who provides or attempts to provide any kickback or solicit, accept or attempt to accept any kickback.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 20 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED 1638, AS AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED 1650, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIIPPINES RETIREMENT LAW
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to grant a separation pay equivalent to one month base pay and longevity pay for every year of active service to the AFP's enlisted personnel who are honorably separated from service before rendering 20 years of active service.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-08-30

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT CURTAILING THE ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES OF RACKETEERS AND POWERFUL SYNDICATES IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Racketeer-Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO) Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Racketeer-Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO) Act of 2004.\" The bill aims to prevent organized crime syndicates from using money and power to subvert and corrupt legitimate businesses by facilitating the prosecution of and imposing stiffer penalties for criminal offenders.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT REDEFINING THE THIRD LEVEL POSITIONS IN THE CAREER CIVIL SERVICE
rows.abstract: The bill proposes the following qualification requirements for third level positions: a) appropriate academic and professional background; b) career service executive eligibility; c) holds a comparable or next in rank position in government; d) meets age requirement; and e) not disqualified under any existing law.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2005-02-02

committee_action.meethigh: integrated to the proposed civil service code

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FREE MEDICAL SERVICES TO FILIPINO VETERANS AND RETIRED GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL IN GOVERNMENT-OWNED AND OPERATED HOSPITALS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: As a gesture of gratitude for their past services and to reassure them of the government's support for them, the bill mandates all government-owned and operated hospitals to provide free medical services to all Filipino veterans and retired government employees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-04

rows.abstract: The bill imposes a penalty of prision mayor or a fine of not less than P10,000 nor more than P15,000 or both for any violation of the act.

rows.abstract: The bill seeks to terminate the services of military personnel in all civilian and public offices and to prohibit their detail or reassignment.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN LOCAL ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION BY MAKING THE APPOINTMENT OF AN ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICER MANDATORY FOR PROVINCIAL, CITY AND MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 484 (A) OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991\"
rows.abstract: Under the Local Government Code, the appointment of an environment and natural resources officer is merely optional for local government units. To prevent the degradation of our ecosystem, the bill makes the appointment of the environment and natural resources officer mandatory.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2004-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A PHILIPPINE CITIZENSHIP IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM
rows.title_short: Philippine Citizenship Identification System Act of 2001
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Citizenship Identification System Act of 2001.\" The bill requires all Filipino citizens, who have reached the age of majority, to secure a citizen's ID from the Bureau of Immigration, which shall have the sole responsibility of issuing the ID.
rows.status: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-09-13

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-09-13

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER STRENGTHENING VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION AS A PREFERENTIAL MODE OF LABOR DISPUTE SETTLEMENT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLES 260, 261, 262-A, 262-B AND 277 (F) OF PD 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to strengthen voluntary arbitration by amending the following: a) the selection of Voluntary Arbitrators or panel of Voluntary Arbitrators; b) redefining the jurisdiction of the Voluntary arbitrators to hear cases of termination of workers, productivity schemes or wage distortions arising from legislated wage increases; c) meting out sanctions against erring arbitrators; d) determining the fees of the arbitrators; and e) providing subsidy for unions that cannot shoulder the fees of arbitrators.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE BENEFITS OF RETIRED GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE COMMONWEALTH ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY-SIX, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant government employees who intend to retire under RA 660 or PD 1146 a 6-year annual lump sum instead of the usual 5-year annuity. The proposed monthly annuity shall be based on the highest monthly salary received prior to retirement instead of basing it on the average monthly salary received during the last 3 years of service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF INSURED BANK DEPOSITS FROM ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (P100,000) TO ONE MILLION PESOS (P1,000,000), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THREE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED NINETY-ONE, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CHARTER OF THE PHILIPPINE DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the maximum amount of insured deposits to P500,000 and to establish a deposit insurance coverage plan for deposits in excess of P500,00 which a depositor, as an option, may enroll in at his cost.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING TRI-SERVICE ACADEMIES FOR THE MAJOR SERVICES COMMAND OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"Tri-Service Academies Act.\" The bill proposes the creation of the Philippine Army Military Academy (PAMA), the Philippine Air Force Military Academy (PAFMA) and the Philippine Naval Military Academy (PNMA) to meet the requirement for officers of the Major Services Command of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.
rows.status: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2006-03-01

committee_action.action: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2006-03-01

rows.title_short: Omnibus Housing and Development Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Omnibus Housing and Development Act of 2004.\" The bill provides for the consolidation of the various shelter agencies and the creation of the Department of Housing and Urban Development which shall formulate and implement all shelter policies and programs.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04264

rows.title_full: AN ACT REDEFINING ILLEGAL RECRUITMENT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS ACT OF 1995,\" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act Amendment of 1998
rows.abstract: \"Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act Amendment of 1998.\" The bill seeks to distinguish acts or omissions by illegal recruiters, which constitue the crime of illegal recruitment, from the prohibited acts or omissions of legitimate and licensed placement or recruitment agencies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT SECURITY, INTELLIGENCE AND CONFIDENTIAL FUNDS BE SUBJECTED TO STANDARD AUDITING PROCEDURES, REQUIRING THE SUBMISSION OF THE AUDIT AND LIQUIDATION REPORTS ON SAID FUNDS TO THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: To ensure that these funds are managed, expended and utilized in accordance with laws and regulations, the bill provides for the regular auditing by the Commission on Audit of all security, intelligence and confidential funds.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A LAND CONVERSION TAX, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the imposition of a 15% land conversion tax on all agricultural lands converted for residential purposes and a 30% tax on all agricultural lands converted for commercial, industrial and other non-agricultural purposes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOCATING FIFTY PERCENT OF VALUE-ADDED TAX COLLECTIONS TO HEALTH AND EDUCATION SERVICES, AGRICULTURAL FACILITES AND SERVICES, HOUSING, ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION, AND OTHER SOCIAL SERVICES THEREBY AMENDING THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to allocate 50% of the total value-added tax collection for the following purposes: a) education - 25%; b) health - 25%; c) agricultural facilities and services - 25%; d) housing - 15%; e) environmental protection - 5%; and f) training and capability building programs - 5%.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCLUDING LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS (LPG) IN THE LIST OF BASIC NECESSITIES AS DEFINED UNDER SECTION 3 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7581, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PRICE ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Liquefield petroleum gas (LPG), being the most commonly used fuel in many households, is actually a basic need. The bill proposes to include LPG in the list of basic commodities so that its price can automatically be controlled or \"frozen\" during calamities, disasters and other emergency situations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 6, PARAGRAPH (1) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7581, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PRICE ACT
rows.abstract: The bill empowers the sanggunian, in areas declared under a state of calamity, to place the prices of basic commodities under control.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09369) enacted on 2007-01-23
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE USE OF THE AUTOMATED TELLER MACHINE (ATM) TECHNOLOGY IN THE CONDUCT OF NATIONAL OR LOCAL ELECTORAL EXERCISES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill calls on the Commission on Elections to customize the automated teller machines (ATM) technology for use in the elections. The system shall involve the use the voter's card containing the personal identification number and automated machine equipped with a biometric identification system to determine the identity of the voter.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05352

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING ALL IRRIGATED AND IRRIGABLE AGRICULTURAL LANDS AS PROTECTED AREAS FOR AGRICULTURE, PROHIBITING ITS CONVERSION FOR USES OTHER THAN AGRICULTURAL AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 20 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.title_short: National Protected Areas for Agriculture (NPAA) Law
rows.abstract: \"National Protected Areas for Agriculture (NPAA) Law.\" To stop the indiscriminate conversion of agricultural lands to residential, commercial and industrial lands, the bill declares all irrigated and irrigable agricultural lands planted with rice, crops, sugar, coconut and other crops as NPAAs and as such, not subject to conversion for other uses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING TO ONE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED PESOS (P1,500) THE MONTHLY PERSONNEL ECONOMIC RELIEF ALLOWANCE (PERA) GRANTED TO GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to grant all government employees a P500 monthly PERA increase effective January 1, 2005. Employees receiving commutable representation and/or transportation allowance shall not be entitled to receive the increase.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE TAX ON IDLE LANDS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 236 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the tax on idle lands from 5% to 10% of the assessed value of the property in addition to the basic real property tax.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT REDEFINING THE CRIME OF PLUNDER THEREBY AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY HUNDRED AND EIGHTY AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY-NINE
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to lower the minimum aggregate amount or total value involved in the crime of plunder from P50 million to P25 million.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FLOATING MEDICAL CENTER TO BE KNOWN AS THE PHILIPPINE FLOATING MEDICAL CENTER AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the Philippine Navy and the Department of Health to jointly maintain and operate the Philippine Floating Medical Center which shall visit the different provinces, municipalities and cities in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM INCOME TAXATION CERTAIN RENTALS ON RESIDENTIAL/APARTMENT OR OTHER DWELLING UNITS, ALLOWING THEM TO BE DEDUCTIBLE FROM TAXABLE FIXED INCOME OF THE TENANTS OR INDIVIDUALS WHO PAY SAID RENTALS
rows.abstract: \"Rental Tax Exemption Law.\" The bill provides that rentals or leases below P5,000 per month for residents in Metro Manila and P2,500 per month for residents outside Metro Manila shall be exempt from taxes and shall be deductible from taxable fixed income.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING THE ENTRY, SALE, PROCESSING, FIELD TESTING AND RELEASE OF PRODUCTS CONSISTING OF, CONTAINING OR DERIVED FROM GENETICALLY MODIFIED ORGANISMS (GMOS) INTO AND WITHIN THE COUNTRY AND IMPOSING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: \"GMO Prohibition Act of 2000.\" The bill prohibits the entry, sale, processing, field testing and release of products containing or derived from genetically modified organisms (GMOs) for five years. It directs the National Committee on Biosafety of the Philippines to establish a procedure for granting permits and monitoring the effects of GMOs on human health and the environment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-05, transmitted to on 2006-04-20 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-20
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNCIPALITY OF LIANGA, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR, TO BE KNOWN AS THE LIANGA NATIONAL COMPREHENSIVE HIGH SCHOOL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05253

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING CHAIN DISTRIBUTION PLANS OR PYRAMID SALES SCHEMES AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-THREE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Pyramid Sales Ban Act.\" The bill proposes to increase the fine for engaging in chain distribution plans or pyramid sales schemes from not more than P10,000 to not more than P1 million.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 450 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to exempt the capital town of a province from the income requirement in the event of conversion into a component city. However, the capital town shall be required to comply with the land area requirement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR GREATER FISCAL AUTONOMY IN FAVOR OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS (LGUs) IN THE CHOICE OF DEPOSITORY BANKS, AMENDING SECTION 311 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill allows local government units, with the concurrence of the sanggunian, to choose the depository bank for their current operating expenditures including personal services. However, they are enjoined to maintain their special funds and capital outlays in government-owned banks.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2005-01-26

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE BRANCH OF SURIGAO DEL SUR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY IN BARANGAY PARANG, MUNICIPALITY OF CANTILAN, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR INTO A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS PARANG NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.author: A071
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF GOVERNMENT AMBULANCES, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Regulating the Use of Government Ambulances
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits the use of government ambulances for: a) office service vehicle, for recreation or for personal use; b) to transport patients not in emergency situtation; and c) for private use for a fee or without.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-08-30, transmitted to on 2006-09-07 and received by the Senate on 2006-09-07

second_reading.remarks: The Body adopted the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.

rows.author: D035
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 4 OF THE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7161, FURTHER AMENDING SECTION 71 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 705, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE REVISED FORESTRY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The Revised Forestry Code of the Philippines strictly prohibits the cutting of mangrove species. The bill proposes to allow the cutting of mangrove species only in cases where such would spur economic activities in the area like the construction of a seaport.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-04

rows.author: D035
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE BURAUEN DISTRICT HOSPITAL IN THE PROVINCE OF LEYTE INTO AN EXTENSION OF THE EASTERN VISAYAS REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER, FURTHER INCREASING ITS BED CAPACITY TO THREE HUNDRED (300) BED HOSPITAL UNDER THE CONTROL AND SUPERVISION OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT, TO BE KNOWN AS THE BURAUEN MEDICAL CENTER, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-04

rows.author: D035
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE CARIGARA DISTRICT HOSPITAL IN THE PROVINCE OF LEYTE INTO AN EXTENSION OF THE EASTERN VISAYAS REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER, FURTHER INCREASING ITS BED CAPACITY TO TWO HUNDRED (200) BED HOSPITAL UNDER THE CONTROL AND SUPERVISION OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT, TO BE KNOWN AS THE CARIGARA GENERAL HOSPITAL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-04

rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09412) enacted on 2007-03-24
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE 20TH DAY OF AUGUST OF EVERY YEAR AS A SPECIAL NON-WORKING HOLIDAY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF DULAG, PROVINCE OF LEYTE, TO BE KNOWN AS MUNICIPAL FOUNDATION DAY
rows.status: Substituted by HB04565

rows.status: Substituted by HB05191

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE SURIGAO DEL SUR POLYTECHNIC STATE COLLEGE (SSPSC)LIANGA CAMPUS IN BARANGAY STO. NIÑO, MUNICIPALITY OF SAN AGUSTIN, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR INTO A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE STO. NIÑO NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CANTILAN, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR, TO BE KNOWN AS THE CANTILAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05556

rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING THE FELISBERTO VERANO HIGH SCHOOL - TIGAO ANNEX IN BARANGAY TIGAO, MUNICIPALITY OF CORTES, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR FROM THE FELISBERTO VERANO HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING THE SAME INTO AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE TIGAO NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05557

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE BRANCH OF SURIGAO DEL SUR POLYTECHNIC STATE COLLEGE IN TARVIA, MUNICIPALITY OF SAN MIGUEL, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR INTO A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE SAN MIGUEL NATIONAL COMPREHENSIVE HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.status: Substituted by HB05527

rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING THE JACINTO P. ELPA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL - BOLHOON ANNEX IN BARANGAY BOLHOON, MUNICIPALITY OF SAN MIGUEL, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR FROM THE JACINTO P. ELPA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING THE SAME INTO AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE BOLHOON NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

rows.status: Substituted by HB05551

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE SURIGAO DEL SUR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - LANUZA CAMPUS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF LANUZA, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR, INTO A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE FLORITA HERRERA IRIZARI NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE MINIMUM SALARY GRADE LEVEL OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS IN ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY LEVELS FROM SALARY GRADE 10 TO SALARY GRADE 18 AND AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to upgrade the salary of public elementary and high school teachers from salary grade 10 to salary grade 18 to compensate them commensurately to their qualifications and to the role they play in educating our youth.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE ALLOWANCES/HONORARIA OF AND GRANTING RETIREMENT BENEFITS TO ALL BARANGAY OFFICIALS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991\"
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the monthly allowance/honorarium of the punong barangay from P1,000 to P6,000 and for the sangguniang barangay members, barangay treasurer and barangay secretary from P600 to P3,000. It also grants retirement benefits to barangay officials who have rendered nine years of cumulative service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE UNLAWFUL IMPORTATION, POSSESSION AND SALE OF CHEMICALS USED AS INGREDIENTS IN THE MANUFACTURE OF EXPLOSIVES
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits the importation, sale or possession of chlorates, nitrates, and nitric acids without the appropriate permit. It requires the keeping of a permanent record of all transactions involving the above chemicals and to keep such record open for inspection by the proper authorities at all times.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING MEDICAL NEUTRALITY BY REPEALING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 169 AS AMENDED BY EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 212, WHICH REQUIRES ANY ATTENDING PHYSICIAN OF ANY HOSPITAL, MEDICAL CLINIC, SANITARIUM OR OTHER MEDICAL ESTABLISHMENTS OR ANY MEDICAL PRACTITIONER WHO HAS TREATED ANY PERSON FOR SERIOUS OR LESS SERIOUS PHYSICAL INJURIES TO REPORT THE FACT OF TREATMENT
rows.abstract: To uphold the confidentiality of the patient-doctor relationship, the bill seeks to repeal the decree that requires doctors to report their treatment for physical injuries to the nearest government health authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING HIGHER AND SIMULTANEOUS PENALTIES OF PRISON TERM AND FINE FOR VIOLATIONS OF GAMBLING LAWS WHENEVER THE OFFENDER IS THE MAINTAINER, CONDUCTOR, BANKER OR GAMBLING LORD, AND ADDITIONAL PENALTY IF THE OFFENDER IS A POLICE OR MILITARY OFFICER OR PERSONNEL OR A LOCAL GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 1 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1602
rows.abstract: The bill increases the penalties for illegal gambling to prision mayor in its minimum term AND a fine of P100,000. If the culprit is a government official or a uniformed personnel, the penalty shall be prision mayor in its maximum term and a fine of P200,000.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: C091
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-05, transmitted to on 2006-04-25 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-25
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE SURIGAO DEL SUR POLYTECHNIC STATE COLLEGE (SSPSC) IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF TANDAG, INCLUDING ITS DULY INTEGRATED CAMPUSES NAMELY:  SSPSC-TAGBINA CAMPUS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF TAGBINA, SSPSC-LIANGA CAMPUS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF LIANGA, SSPSC-CAGWAIT CAMPUS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN MIGUEL AND SSPSC-CANTILAN CAMPUS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CANTILAN, ALL LOCATED IN THE PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR, INTO A STATE UNIVERSITY TO BE KNOWN AS THE SURIGAO DEL SUR STATE UNIVERSITY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB04927

rows.author: E023
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-05, transmitted to on 2006-04-25 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-25
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THREE (3) BRANCHES OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURT IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CABUYAO, LAGUNA AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE OF SECTION FOURTEEN OF BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 129 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE JUDICIARY REORGANIZATION ACT OF 1980, AS AMENDED, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Substituted by HB05125

rows.author: E023
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE BARANGAY INTEGRATED DEVELOPMENT APPROACH FOR NUTRITION IMPROVEMENT (BIDANI) OF THE RURAL POOR AS A NETWORK PROGRAM OF PARTICIPATING STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITITES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"BIDANI Act of 2004.\" BIDANI refers to nutrition-in-development action research program which aims to assist the government in improving the nutrition and general well-being of the rural poor through participating state colleges and universities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-04

rows.author: E023
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING PRIVILEGES FOR SENIOR CITIZENS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION FOUR  OF REPUBLIC ACT 7432 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT TO MAXIMIZE THE CONTRIBUTION OF SENIOR CITIZENS TO NATION BUILDING, GRANT BENEFITS AND SPECIAL PRIVILEGES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES\"
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to increase the 20% discount being enjoyed by senior citizens to 40%.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2004-08-04

rows.author: E023
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-12-04, transmitted to on 2006-12-07 and received by the Senate on 2006-12-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR ONE (1) BRANCH OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURT IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF LOS BANOS, LAGUNA AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE OF SECTION FOURTEEN OF BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 129 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE JUDICIARY REORGANIZATION ACT OF 1980, AS AMENDED, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Substituted by HB05945

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING HARBOR PILOT AGE SERVICES AND THE CONDUCT OF HARBOR PILOTS IN ALL PORTS IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR RELATED PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Pilotage Service Act of 2004.\" The bill authorizes the Philippine Sports Authority to establish pilotage districts throughout the country and to determine pilotage rates.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THIRTY-EIGHT HUNDRED THIRTY-FIVE, ENTITLED \"AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE WOMEN'S AUXILIARY CORPS IN THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES TO PROVIDE FOR THE PROCUREMENT OF ITS OFFICERS AND ENLISTED PERSONNEL AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to allow the members of the Philippine Auxiliary Corps to perform COMBAT DUTY.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-08-30

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-08-30
committee_action.remarks: bill to be consolidated with HB 5766 otherwise known as the National Defense Act
